decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch with sound extends the firm's established arch and lighting expertise, so its absorptive capacity remains high and the product can be improved rather than dropped.
The one-tier Christmas pyramid builds directly on existing pyramid craftsmanship, enabling the firm to assimilate market feedback and continue refining it.
The Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid leverages the firm's established carving and painting knowledge, so the firm can interpret results and keep improving it.
